svg.title: A changed objective can change visibility
svg.desc: Synthetic museum clips: M1 completion .8, match 1; M2 .9, match 0; Rule A: completion + 2 × match → M1 = 2.8; M2 = .9; Rule B: 3 × completion + .2 × match → M1 = 2.6; M2 = 2.7; M2 moves above M1 because completion now matters more; Scores are teaching units, not income, quality or proof of user preference.
svg.text: A changed objective can change visibility
Synthetic museum clips: M1 completion .8, match 1; M2 .9, match 0
Rule A: completion + 2 × match → M1 = 2.8; M2 = .9
Rule B: 3 × completion + .2 × match → M1 = 2.6; M2 = 2.7
M2 moves above M1 because completion now matters more
Scores are teaching units, not income, quality or proof of user preference.
